Every capability runs through a bounded PowerShell child"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"n has no native binary dependency. Every capability runs through a bounded PowerShell child process:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Capture uses `System.Drawing.CopyFromScreen`.
- Window discovery uses Win32 `EnumWindows`, `GetWin"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"dowTextW`, `GetWindowRect`, and foreground-window APIs.
- Element discovery uses Windows UI Automati"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"on, which lets text-only models locate native/accessibility-aware controls without seeing screenshot"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s.
- OCR uses Windows.Media.Ocr for text and coordinate extraction from screenshots or window captur"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"es when UI Automation cannot see inside custom-rendered apps.
- Visual observation combines OCR with"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" coarse layout regions, suggested actions, media-control state, and simple icon/button heuristics so"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" text-only models get a basic UI map instead of a raw image path.
- Pointer input uses `SetCursorPos"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"` and `mouse_event`.
- Text input uses clipboard plus `System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys` as the reliabl"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"e path under Sangfor/VDI filtering, with SendInput fallback.
- All PowerShell processes opt into DPI"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" awareness and UTF-8 output so UIA rectangles, screenshots, and click coordinates use one physical-p"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ixel coordinate space."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Requires the dsh CLI on Windows."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Using Agent Teams through Oh My DSH? Use this"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" project's GitHub Release URL to install this implementation."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"To develop from a checkout:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Or install a packed tarball:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Patch the `computer-use-win` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Set `requireApproval: false` only for unattended tests or disposable environments."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Windows input injection is global: clicks go to whatever is under the coordinates.
- Elevated admi"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"nistrator windows may ignore input from a non-elevated plugin process.
- Win-key combinations fall b"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ack to SendInput, which some VDI products filter. Prefer semantic tools such as `computer_open_setti"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ngs` where possible.
- UI Automation coverage depends on the target application exposing useful acce"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ssibility metadata. CEF/Chromium/Electron/custom-rendered windows may expose only a shell pane; use "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"`computer_observe_window`, `computer_observe_media_controls`, `computer_search_in_window`, `computer"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"_ocr_window`, `computer_locate_text`, or `computer_click_text` for those apps.
- Text-only DeepSeek "},{"id":"p31s8","text":"routes cannot inspect screenshot pixels directly. `computer_screenshot` returns a saved PNG path on "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"those routes; use observation/OCR tools to turn that path/window into text, UI regions, visual candi"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"dates, and click coordinates.
- Visual observation is not a vision model. Icon/button candidates are"},{"id":"p31s11","text":" heuristics with confidence and evidence; verify after clicking."}],"truncated":true}
